# Sangban

\\nThe Sangban is the middle size drum of the dundun set and often plays the defining phase of a rhythm.  This drum can be either a soft or hard wood depending on the tone and projection required. These drums are fitted with Australian cow hide on both sides using top quality marine rope. These drums are made to order and you have the option to choose your own rope and fabric colours to complete your individual design.
